videos.title: Create Mod Train through an Aether Portal?

entry: Build a Nether-portal-shaped frame out of GLOWSTONE, then activate it with a minecraft:water_bucket instead of flint and steel. Corroborated by two videos.

sU7qsFUc0jw: 'I'd make this little glowstone portal here. I'd put down my bucket of water.' ae0hShtfkeY independently says the same - build the frame 'using a bright stone and a cloud of water instead of a stone of the obsidian' (a heavily accented transcription of glowstone + water replacing obsidian + flint and steel).
So the two swaps versus a Nether portal are: minecraft:glowstone for obsidian, and minecraft:water_bucket for the igniter. That is the fact a questbook needs.
Exact frame dimensions are NOT reliably captured - sU7qsFUc0jw only hedges that 'Aether portals can only be this size, like I remember back in the day'.
boss_order: A THREE-DUNGEON LADDER, each boss dropping the key to the next tier. Source piJ3Fm_xiNA (a German showcase, transcribed roughly, so names are mangled but the structure is unambiguous).

1. BRONZE DUNGEON -> aether:slider. The guide's tactic: it is easy to dodge, and 'if you add damage to it, it increases its movement speed', so burst damage makes the fight harder, not easier. On death it drops aether:bronze_dungeon_key, which opens a treasure chest that appears directly UNDER the boss room.

Bronze loot named in the guide: aether:valkyrie_lance (very long reach), aether:lightning_knife (throwable, calls lightning where it lands), aether:flaming_sword, aether:phoenix_bow (ignites mobs), aether:hammer_of_kingbdogz (melee plus a ranged projectile) and aether:cloud_staff.

2. SILVER DUNGEON -> aether:valkyrie_queen. The dungeon floats in the sky and looks like an ancient Greek building, with mimic chests and passive-but-lethal aether:valkyrie mobs that only fight back if attacked.
GATE: the queen will not fight you until you collect TEN aether:victory_medal from killing ordinary valkyries and hand them over. On death she drops aether:silver_dungeon_key.

The guide explicitly advises doing the Bronze Dungeon FIRST and taking its loot in, because aether:valkyrie_lance's reach is a large advantage over vanilla gear for this fight - and to bring golden apples.

3. GOLD DUNGEON - aether:gold_dungeon_key exists in the jar and the silver key 'opens a more powerful gate with even stronger loot'. The guide does NOT describe the gold dungeon's boss fight, so aether:sun_spirit is present in the jar but its fight is NOT sourced here.
Silver loot named: aether:valkyrie_axe / aether:valkyrie_pickaxe and the rest of the valkyrie tools (greater reach), aether:holy_sword (extra damage to undead), and the valkyrie armour set.
order: You arrive in the sky. Clouds are walkable and you take no fall damage landing on them, though you fall through the top block (sU7qsFUc0jw).
aether:ambrosium_shard is the basic resource and fuels the mod's altar; aether:ambrosium_torch is the local light source.

Ore progression runs through aether:ambrosium_ore and zanite up to gravitite: raw gravitite is ENCHANTED in the altar to make aether:enchanted_gravitite, which is what the aether:gravitite_chestplate tier is built from.
Do the Bronze Dungeon before the Silver Dungeon - the guide states this directly as a difficulty shortcut.
gates: HARD GATE: aether:valkyrie_queen ignores you until you give her 10x aether:victory_medal farmed from ordinary aether:valkyrie mobs.
Each dungeon tier is locked behind the previous boss's key: aether:bronze_dungeon_key, then aether:silver_dungeon_key, then aether:gold_dungeon_key.
traps: Falling off the edge of the Aether drops you back into the Overworld at your spawn point (sU7qsFUc0jw: 'if I jump down I end up in my spawn point').
Do NOT attack aether:valkyrie mobs casually - they are non-hostile but 'cause a lot of damage if you do not wear a strong armor'. The guide says it would not attack them without reason.
Silver Dungeon chests include mimics that imitate ordinary chests and attack.
Hitting aether:slider harder makes it FASTER - the one boss where more damage per hit is a downside.
signature: aether:bronze_dungeon_key, aether:silver_dungeon_key, aether:gold_dungeon_key - the three keys ARE the progression.
aether:victory_medal - the ten-medal toll that gates the Valkyrie Queen.
aether:valkyrie_lance and the valkyrie tool set - the mod's signature long-reach weapons.
aether:enchanted_gravitite and the aether:gravitite_chestplate tier - the top armour material.
aether:phoenix_bow, aether:lightning_knife, aether:flaming_sword, aether:hammer_of_kingbdogz, aether:cloud_staff - the uncraftable dungeon-only weapons.
aether:ambrosium_shard - the first Aether resource a player picks up.
